# tu 1.1.0 — full-screen popup and a status-bar button

`tu` no longer needs a spare tmux window. Run it from any pane and it
opens full-screen over your work; or click the new ` tu ` button on
the status bar.

## What's new since `v1.0.0`

- **Full-screen popup inside tmux.** On tmux ≥ 3.2, running `tu`
  from a pane re-launches it in `display-popup -E -w 100% -h 100%`
  (borderless with `-B` on ≥ 3.3) and hands the pane back when it
  closes. `--no-popup` or `TU_NO_POPUP=1` keeps the inline behaviour.
  The popup instance is recognised by `$TMUX` without `$TMUX_PANE`, so
  your own `display-popup … tu` bindings never nest.
- **Status-bar ` tu ` button.** The first-launch `~/.tmux.conf` check
  now offers a bold ` tu ` label at the right end of the status line
  bound to the same full-screen popup. Clicks elsewhere on the bar keep
  tmux's default. The block is written between `# Added by tu` and
  `# End of tu`, and is applied to the running server immediately:

  ```tmux
  # Added by tu (https://github.com/hungryZoo/tu)
  set -g mouse on
  set -g history-limit 10000000
  set -g status-right-length 60
  set -ag status-right "#[range=user|tu]#[fg=#1e1e2e,bg=#cba6f7,bold] tu #[norange]#[default]"
  bind -T root MouseDown1Status \
    if -F '#{==:#{mouse_status_range},tu}' \
      'display-popup -E -B -w 100% -h 100% tu' \
      'select-window -t ='
  # End of tu
  ```

  The button is detected by its `range=user|tu` marker, so you can
  restyle it and `tu` still counts it as configured. It is only
  offered on tmux ≥ 3.2.
- **Cancel (Esc) replaces Quit (q).** The button just closes `tu`;
  `q` is no longer a shortcut. Ctrl-C still works.
- **Backspace is the Delete key.** It is the key labelled *delete* on
  Mac keyboards; forward-Delete keeps working.

## Install

### Quick install (macOS & Linux, no sudo)

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hungryZoo/tu/main/install.sh | sh
```

### macOS — Homebrew tap

```bash
brew tap hungryZoo/tu https://github.com/hungryZoo/tu
brew install tu
```

### Linux — `.deb`

```bash
curl -LO https://github.com/hungryZoo/tu/releases/download/v1.1.0/tu_1.1.0_amd64.deb && sudo dpkg -i tu_1.1.0_amd64.deb   # x86_64
curl -LO https://github.com/hungryZoo/tu/releases/download/v1.1.0/tu_1.1.0_arm64.deb && sudo dpkg -i tu_1.1.0_arm64.deb   # ARM64
curl -LO https://github.com/hungryZoo/tu/releases/download/v1.1.0/tu_1.1.0_armhf.deb && sudo dpkg -i tu_1.1.0_armhf.deb   # ARMv7
```

### Linux — `.rpm`

```bash
sudo rpm -i https://github.com/hungryZoo/tu/releases/download/v1.1.0/tu-1.1.0-1.x86_64.rpm    # x86_64
sudo rpm -i https://github.com/hungryZoo/tu/releases/download/v1.1.0/tu-1.1.0-1.aarch64.rpm   # ARM64
```

### Anywhere — tarball

```bash
tar -xzf tu-1.1.0-<triple>.tar.gz
install -m 0755 tu ~/.local/bin/tu
```

| Triple                          | Notes                                            |
| ------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `aarch64-apple-darwin`          | macOS, Apple Silicon                             |
| `x86_64-apple-darwin`           | macOS, Intel                                     |
| `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`      | Linux x86_64, dynamic glibc (≥ 2.17)             |
| `x86_64-unknown-linux-musl`     | Linux x86_64, fully static                       |
| `aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu`     | Linux ARM64 (Raspberry Pi 3/4/5 in 64-bit OS)    |
| `aarch64-unknown-linux-musl`    | Linux ARM64, fully static                        |
| `armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf` | Raspberry Pi 2/3/4/5 running 32-bit Pi OS        |

### Verifying

```bash
shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing
```

## Notes

- The status-bar binding runs plain `tu`, resolved through the tmux
  server's `PATH`. If tmux can't find it (e.g. `~/.local/bin` only on
  your interactive shell's `PATH`), point the binding at the absolute
  path.
- tmux < 3.2 keeps the 1.0.0 behaviour: inline in the pane, no button.
